description:
Analyse how component tolerances affect your filter's passband ripple and stopband rejection.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Free lane: monteCarloIterations max 1000. Cross-parameter checks: filter_parts_ladder, filter_pass_criteria. Time budget 180 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"filterType":"butterworth","bandType":"lowpass","order":5,"freqCutoff":1000000000,"ripple":0.5,"impedance":50}
Returns: The yield and its 95% confidence interval against the ripple and rejection limits or the entered pass criteria and a target, failures and statistics per criterion with each part's share of the variance, failing trials, what-ifs on the same trials, and the envelope, sample trials and responses as series. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

bandType.description: Band Type. omit for the default of "lowpass"

componentTolerance.description: Component Tolerance (%). min 0, max 50. omit for the default of 5

filterType.description: Filter Type. omit for the default of "butterworth"

freqCutoff.description: Cutoff Frequency (Hz). -3 dB frequency for Butterworth; passband edge for Chebyshev. min 1000. omit for the default of 1000000000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

impedance.description: System Impedance (Ω). min 1. omit for the default of 50

monteCarloIterations.description: Monte Carlo Trials. Free tier: max 1,000. Pro and API: up to 100,000, as many as fit the run time allowed for the ladder and criteria. min 50, max 100000. omit for the default of 500. bound on the free tier: max 1000

order.description: Filter Order. min 2, max 9. omit for the default of 5

parts.description: Circuit Parts. The ladder as built, source to load, 1 to 20 parts: { ref, kind: L | C, position: series | shunt, value in henries or farads, tolerance in % (optional; Component Tolerance when absent) }. Simulated as given, with no E24 rounding. Blank synthesises the ladder from the filter type, band, order and cutoff. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

passCriteria.description: Pass Criteria. What a build must meet to pass, 1 to 8 criteria, in place of the passband variation and stopband rejection limits: { kind: insertionLoss, fStart, fStop, maxDb }, { kind: cutoff3dB, fMin, fMax } or { kind: attenuation, freq (or fStart and fStop), minDb }; frequencies in Hz. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

randomSeed.description: Random Seed. Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design. min 0. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

rejectionSpec_db.description: Stopband Rejection Minimum (optional) (dB). Smallest rejection a build must reach from 2× the cutoff upward (low-pass) or below half the cutoff (high-pass). Leave blank to allow 3 dB less than the standard-value design achieves. min 0, max 200

ripple.description: Passband Ripple (dB). Chebyshev only. min 0.01, max 3. omit for the default of 0.5

rippleSpec_db.description: Passband Variation Limit (optional) (dB). Largest peak-to-peak |S21| variation across the passband for a build to pass. Leave blank to allow 0.5 dB more than the standard-value design achieves. min 0, max 20

toleranceDistribution.description: Distribution. omit for the default of "uniform"

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

yieldTarget.description: Yield Target (optional) (%). The share of builds that must pass. Blank means 95 %. min 0, max 100. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

name: simulate_filter_monte_carlo
title: RF Filter Monte Carlo Analysis
